breaking_news.headline: Are you choosing to stay single? We want to hear from you
breaking_news.summary: Solo living, solo travel, and solo dining are all being embraced as more adults are choosing to remain single. Many Americans aren't interested in dating, and being single is a symbol of autonomy.

breaking_news.headline: Mortgage rates hit their highest level in a year, driven by war and inflation concerns
breaking_news.summary: The 30-year fixed-rate mortgage reached 6.66% on average Thursday.

breaking_news.headline: Oil companies report sky-high profits thanks to wartime crude prices
breaking_news.summary: Chevron reported its highest quarterly earnings ever. Shell had its second-biggest quarter, and ExxonMobil doubled its earnings compared with the same time last year.

breaking_news.headline: FIFA scraps controversial deal to sell stakes in World Cup to private investors
breaking_news.summary: FIFA abandoned a plan to create a commercial venture and then sell stakes to minority investors, just days after unveiling it. The plan drew sharp condemnation — and a boycott from European nations.

breaking_news.headline: For sale: early access to Trump's Truth Social posts
breaking_news.summary: The president's media company is offering investors early access to his Truth Social feed for up to $100,000 a month. Experts say the service may violate insider trading laws.

breaking_news.headline: Why did OpenAI's and Anthropic's AI models hack other companies?
breaking_news.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic say their models broke into other companies' systems during testing, raising security concerns amid a heated debate over how to regulate AI.

breaking_news.headline: Capital One says it closed Trump Organization accounts over money-laundering concerns
breaking_news.summary: The bank is asking a judge to permanently dismiss a lawsuit from Trump-affiliated businesses, arguing a monthslong internal review — not the Jan. 6 riot — explains why hundreds of accounts were shut down in 2021.

breaking_news.headline: For those with criminal records, AI is breaking down barriers to employment
breaking_news.summary: Tens of millions of Americans have criminal records that can be barriers to employment. An AI-powered app is helping those eligible to expunge their records at a pace not seen before.

breaking_news.headline: Aung San Suu Kyi appears healthy in first confirmed outside contact for 2.5 years
breaking_news.summary: Photos newly released by Myanmar's military government show Suu Kyi meeting with an ICRC official.

breaking_news.headline: Russian anti-war politician says he has fled the country
breaking_news.summary: Boris Nadezhdin, who was recently designated as a foreign agent, posted a video in front of the Eiffel Tower.

breaking_news.headline: Infantino opponents threaten 'non co-operation' with Fifa
breaking_news.summary: Opponents of Fifa president Gianni Infantino are threatening "non co-operation" with the governing body unless he steps down, according to senior Uefa sources.

breaking_news.headline: US reports first two deaths linked to  'explosive diarrhoea' outbreak
breaking_news.summary: The illness caused by parasitic infection that spreads through contaminated food or water is not generally life-threatening, health officials say.

breaking_news.headline: Rhine falls to record low levels as drought strains Europe's rivers
breaking_news.summary: Low water levels in the Rhine, Danube and Po have curtailed the transport of goods and reduced electricity output.

breaking_news.headline: Iran says it is in talks with Oman but not the US after Trump says negotiations to resume
breaking_news.summary: Iran's remarks that there were no talks with the US prompts Donald Trump to issue a strong condemnation of its leadership.

breaking_news.headline: Russia says seven killed and 40 injured by Ukrainian drone hitting busy beach
breaking_news.summary: Three children were killed when the drone crashed at a popular resort on the Black Sea.

breaking_news.headline: Snapchat joins other popular platforms in fight against 'AI slop'
breaking_news.summary: Snapchat, YouTube, LinkedIn, and Substack are trying to combat the proliferation of fake AI content.

breaking_news.headline: Faisal Islam: Four reasons why Fifa's World Cup plan never stacked up
breaking_news.summary: The actual presentation of FIFA's plan to part-privatise the World Cup raises many more questions than it answers.

breaking_news.headline: US and Japan take action to prop up yen in rare joint move
breaking_news.summary: Both countries have said that they will not hesitate to conduct joint interventions in the future.

breaking_news.headline: New Spider-Man film sees second-biggest ever global opening weekend
breaking_news.summary: The strong box office performance gives a boost to Disney ahead of the much-anticipated Avengers: Doomsday.

breaking_news.headline: Xbox Series X price hiked by £170 due to rising memory chip costs
breaking_news.summary: Xbox consoles now cost significantly more in the UK, with one model increasing in price by 43%.
